ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; high-intensity pixels are isolated to less than 5 percent of the total visible ventral fluke area, primarily concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous low-intensity (black) mass covering the visible ventral surface. Distal tips exhibit high-contrast, heterogeneous clusters of white and tan pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of valleys and peaks varies along the boundary, reaching maximum irregularity toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex trajectory from the central notch, transitioning to a steep upward curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast (white/beige) pixels at both distal tips; sparse, isolated white pixels scattered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distal tip encrustation (bio-fouling); irregular notches and indentations along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
